title: When the soul asks the way, do not walk alone
summary: This meets the late realization that appetite has not taught the way home. The line says the soul must ask direction, because the world without the Guru is already drowning.
takeaway: Seek direction before desire sets the route.
lifeApplication: At the end of the day, when success still feels directionless, stop at the doorway before the next task. Ask plainly where this life is being led, and do not let appetite answer for you.

source.shortMeaning: The soul needs the Guru's direction before desire makes it drown.
source.lifeApplication: When you feel lost, ask for direction before you follow the next impulse.

evidence.coreClaim: The soul needs the Guru's direction before desire makes it drown.
evidence.turn: Greed becomes easier to face when its growth is named.
